2.2.value: 12.50% incentive fee, calculated PER INVESTMENT (deal-by-deal) on each Direct, Secondary, Listed PE and Opportunistic investment. Waterfall: (i) 100% of proceeds retained by Fund until return of acquisition cost + Preferred Return (8%/yr compounded annually; 6%/yr for Direct Credit); (ii) 100% catch-up to Adviser until Adviser holds 12.50% of preferred return + catch-up; (iii) thereafter 12.50% of further proceeds to Adviser. No incentive fee on Primary Fund Investments, currency hedging, or cash equivalents. Accrued monthly, payable on exit from each investment. Measured drag on NII ratio: 1.45% (N-CSR fn.5). NOTE: terms are from the 2021 base prospectus; the on-disk 424B3 supplement (2026-05-08) contains NO fee changes (officer appointment only), but it references a 2025-08-01 prospectus not on disk, so 'terms unchanged through 2026' is not fully confirmed.

3.9.value: Verdict: CONDITIONAL. STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity; this wrapper deals 4x/year. Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure — CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5). Capacity: 4x per year at 5.0% of net assets — a FUND-level cap; at a 5% plan allocation the plan's position is far inside it unless offers are oversubscribed.
